# Quick Links

A command-line utility that opens frequently used URLs from a config file.

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g quick-links
```

## Usage

```bash
quick-links open work
quick-links list
```

## Configuration

Edit `~/.quick-links.yaml`:

```yaml
work:
  - https://github.com
  - https://docs.example.com
```
